Filling.name: Filling
Filling.statement:
structure Filling where
  (N : ℕ) (levelPrime : _ → ℕ) (piBar : (𝔸f E)ˣ) (ϖ : 𝓞 E) (b) chosenPlaces : Fin 2 → Set (FinPlace E)
  [fintypeChosen (i) : Fintype (chosenPlaces i)]
  (columnLevel) (aut_columnLevel (g) : classAut (stdSpace E 𝔰.κ).Γf columnLevel g = ⊥) [hasFiniteType_columnLevel : IsLevel columnLevel]
  besselSys : InfinitePlace E → BesselSystem 𝔰 b (numInfPlaces E)
  piBar_mul_star : piBar * star piBar.1 = N
  N_prime : N.Prime
  N_split (w : FinPlace E) : v (piBar.1 w) = 1 ∨ w.q = N ∧ v (piBar.1 (star w)) = 1
  piBar_mem : ↑piBar ∈ Ô E
  levelPrime_prime i : (levelPrime i).Prime ∧ levelPrime i ≠ N
  le_levelPrime i : b ^ 10 ≤ levelPrime i
  levelPrime_le i : levelPrime i ≤ b ^ 11
  chosenPlaces_q i : ∀ w ∈ chosenPlaces i, w.q = levelPrime i
  chosenPlaces_injective : (·.2.1 : (Σ i, chosenPlaces i) → _).Injective
  star_notMem_chosenPlaces {i j w} : w ∈ chosenPlaces i → star w ∉ chosenPlaces j
  g_dvd_iff r : ↑(levelPrime 0 * levelPrime 1) ∣ r ↔ ∀ p : Σ i, chosenPlaces i, reduceAt p.2 r = 0 ∧ reduceAt p.2.1 (star r) = 0
  card_chosenPlaces i : card (chosenPlaces i) = numInfPlaces E
  star_ϖ : star ϖ = -ϖ
  span_ϖ : differentIdeal ℤ _ = .span {ϖ}
  /-- The rank ϱ is at least 10⁵. -/
  ϱ_le : 10 ^ 5 ≤ 𝔰.ϱ
  pow_six_le : 2⁻¹ ^ 𝔰.ϱ ≤ b⁻¹ ^ 6
  degree_le : (𝔰.ϱ + 1) * Module.finrank ℚ E ≤ 2 ^ (2 * 𝔰.ϱ)
  pow_le_k : 1000 * (2 * 𝔰.ϱ + 2) ^ 9 ≤ 𝔰.k
  ϱ_le_k : 1000 * (2 * 𝔰.ϱ + 2) ≤ 𝔰.k
  k_le_f : 𝔰.k ≤ numInfPlaces E
  size_le : (200 * (numInfPlaces E * 𝔰.k) * rootDiscr E) ^ 1000 ≤ b
  f_le_b : numInfPlaces E ≤ b / 1000
  k_le_b : 𝔰.k ≤ b
  rd_le_b : rootDiscr E ≤ b
  succ_le_b : ↑(𝔰.ϱ + 1) ≤ b
  thousand_le_b : 1000 ≤ b
  one_le_b : 1 ≤ b
  g_le_b_pow : ↑(levelPrime 0 * levelPrime 1) ≤ b ^ 23
  le_g : b ^ 19 ≤ ↑(levelPrime 0 * levelPrime 1)
  le_N : (5 : ℝ) ≤ N
  pow_chain : 10 ^ 10 * 𝔰.n ^ 4 ≤ 𝔰.n ^ 6 ∧ 3 * 𝔰.n ^ 6 + 12 ≤ 𝔰.n ^ 7 ∧ 𝔰.n ^ 7 ≤ 𝔰.k

  besselU ⊓ (S.principalLevel.comap (MulAut.conj (S.h c)⁻¹)).comap S.ratToFin

IsBoxPartition.name: Filling.IsBoxPartition
IsBoxPartition.statement:
def IsBoxPartition (ω : _ → ENNReal) := Measurable ω ∧
  (∀ y v, ω y ≠ 0 → InCut (y v) S.b → y v ∈ frameBox S.boxSize) ∧ (∀ y (a : S.classUnip c → _),
  (∀ γ, ∑' u : (S.classUnip₀ c).subgroupOf _, a (u.1 * γ) = 1) → ∑' γ, a γ * ω (S.ratToInf γ *
  y) = 1) ∧ (∀ y, ω y ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ s y, (∀ v, s v ∈ besselU0 ⊔ besselH) → ω (s * y) = ω y

besselFn.name: Filling.besselFn
besselFn.statement: def besselFn (i : S.BesselCoord) := ∏ v, (S.besselSys v).W σ (y v) (i v)

besselKernel.name: Filling.besselKernel
besselKernel.statement:
def besselKernel : EuclideanSpace ℂ (S.BesselCoord × S.BesselCoord) :=
  .toLp 2 fun i ↦ S.besselFn y i.1 * star (S.besselFn ((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y) i.2)

columnDim.name: Filling.columnDim
columnDim.statement: def columnDim := card S.Classes * card S.BesselCoord

mainEnergy.name: Filling.mainEnergy
mainEnergy.statement: def mainEnergy := S.columnDim ^ 2 / (S.besselDegree * mass E 𝔰.r)

unipOrder.name: Filling.unipOrder
unipOrder.statement: abbrev unipOrder := S.g ^ (numInfPlaces E * (𝔰.ϱ * (2 * 𝔰.k + 2 * 𝔰.ϱ + 1)))

packetConst.name: Filling.packetConst
packetConst.statement: def packetConst := Nat.card (S.reducedImage besselS) * S.unipOrder * card S.Classes * S.siegelConst

besselEnergy.name: Filling.besselEnergy
besselEnergy.statement: def besselEnergy : ℝ := Nat.card (S.reducedImage besselS) * S.columnDim

tailScale.name: Filling.tailScale
tailScale.statement: def tailScale := S.b ^ (𝔰.k * numInfPlaces E / 4 : ℝ)

codimFactor.name: Filling.codimFactor
codimFactor.statement: abbrev codimFactor := (S.b / S.g) ^ (𝔰.k * numInfPlaces E) * (2 * S.tailScale ^ 2)

IsAdmissible.name: Filling.IsAdmissible
IsAdmissible.statement:
class IsAdmissible where
  columnLevel_eq : S.columnLevel = S.principalLevel.comap S.inclHFin
  reduction_surjective : Function.Surjective S.reduction
  ϖ_le v : ‖Φ v S.ϖ.val‖ ≤ S.b
  one_le_abs_kappa v : 1 ≤ |S.kappa v|
  abs_kappa_le v : |S.kappa v| ≤ S.b ^ 23
  N_le : S.N ≤ S.b ^ (60 * 𝔰.n)
  prod_band_le_inv_deg : ∏ v, 𝔰.bandConst * S.b ^ (7 * 𝔰.k) *
    (|S.kappa v| ^ (2 * 𝔰.ϱ + 1) / (S.g * S.N)) ^ (𝔰.k - 𝔰.n ^ 7) ≤ S.besselDegree⁻¹
  besselEnergy_le : S.tailScale ^ 44 * S.besselEnergy ≤ S.mainEnergy
  mainEnergy_le : S.tailScale ^ 18 * S.codimFactor * S.mainEnergy ≤ S.besselEnergy
  codimFactor_le_one : S.codimFactor ≤ 1
  card_besselCoord_le : card S.BesselCoord ≤ S.b ^ (2 * 𝔰.k * numInfPlaces E)
  le_relIndex : (S.N ^ 𝔰.k / S.b) ^ numInfPlaces E ≤
    (S.latStabilizer.comap S.inclHFin).relIndex (Kf E _)
  packetConst_mul_mass_le : S.packetConst ≤
    (1 + S.b⁻¹ ^ 9) * S.mainEnergy * S.besselDegree * 𝔰.openCellConst ^ numInfPlaces E /
    volÔ E ^ 𝔰.n * (S.unipCovolume * S.frameScaleProd / card S.BesselCoord) ^ 2

adelicToInfapply.name: Filling.adelicToInf_apply
adelicToInfapply.statement:
lemma adelicToInf_apply : (S.adelicToInf γ v).1 i j = (γ.1 i j).1 v *
  (S.basisScale v j / S.basisScale v i)

ratToInfapply.name: Filling.ratToInf_apply
ratToInfapply.statement:
@[simp] lemma ratToInf_apply : (S.ratToInf γ v).1 i j =
  Φ v (γ.1 i j) * (S.basisScale v j / S.basisScale v i)

coeratToFin.name: Filling.coe_ratToFin
coeratToFin.statement: lemma coe_ratToFin : S.ratToFin γ = S.latBasis⁻¹ * .map (algebraMap E _) γ * S.latBasis

finiteclassUnipintercompact.name: Filling.finite_classUnip_inter_compact
finiteclassUnipintercompact.statement:
lemma finite_classUnip_inter_compact {m} [Finite m] (f : m → _) {C} (hC : IsCompact C) : (C ∩ range
  fun (u : S.classUnip c) v ↦ (S.ratToInf u v).1.1.submatrix f f).Finite

classCutoff.name: Filling.classCutoff
classCutoff.statement:
@[irreducible] def classCutoff := (S.exists_cutoff_classUnip
  ((S.classUnip₀ c).subgroupOf (S.classUnip c))).choose * epsilon (S.IsBoxPartition c)

amplitude.name: Filling.amplitude
amplitude.statement:
def amplitude := ∫ y,
  (S.classCutoff c y * S.classCutoff c' ((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y)).toReal • S.besselKernel γ y

amplitudeAbs.name: Filling.amplitudeAbs
amplitudeAbs.statement:
def amplitudeAbs := ∫⁻ y,
  S.classCutoff c y * S.classCutoff c' ((S.ratToInf γ)⁻¹ * y) * ‖S.besselKernel γ y‖ₑ

amplitudeSum.name: Filling.amplitudeSum
amplitudeSum.statement: def amplitudeSum := ∑' γ : ↥(T ∩ S.termsOver c s c'), S.amplitude c c' γ

abskappaeq.name: Filling.abs_kappa_eq
abskappaeq.statement: lemma abs_kappa_eq : |S.kappa v| = S.g * ‖Φ v S.ϖ‖ / (2 * π)

realFrameGramratToInf.name: Filling.realFrameGram_ratToInf
realFrameGramratToInf.statement:
@[simp] lemma realFrameGram_ratToInf : ∀ a b, realFrameGram (S.ratToInf γ v) a b =
  ↑(S.kappa v ^ (𝔰.ϱ - a) * S.kappa v ^ (𝔰.ϱ - b) /
  S.N) * Φ v (S.frameProducts γ a b)

detsubmatrixrealFrameGramratToInf.name: Filling.det_submatrix_realFrameGram_ratToInf
detsubmatrixrealFrameGramratToInf.statement:
lemma det_submatrix_realFrameGram_ratToInf {n} [Fintype n] (e : n → _) :
  ((realFrameGram (S.ratToInf γ v)).submatrix e e).det = (∏ a, delta% S.frameScaleSq v (e a)) * Φ v
  ((S.frameProducts γ).submatrix e e).det

gIdele.name: Filling.gIdele
gIdele.statement: def gIdele : (𝔸f E)ˣ := .map (algebraMap E _).1 (.mk0 S.g (by simp))

unipotentChar.name: Filling.unipotentChar
unipotentChar.statement: def unipotentChar (u : S.GFin) := S.selfDualChar (S.gIdele⁻¹ * simpleRootSum u)

Agrees.name: Filling.Agrees
Agrees.statement:
def Agrees := ∀ u u', u.1 ∈ besselU → u'.1 ∈ besselU → S.reduction u * s = s * S.reduction u' →
  S.unipotentChar u = S.unipotentChar u'

IsStable.name: Filling.IsStable
IsStable.statement: def IsStable := ∀ᵉ (u ∈ besselU) (u' ∈ besselU) (γ), u⁻¹ * γ * u' ∈ T ↔ γ ∈ T

termsOfLink.name: Filling.termsOfLink
termsOfLink.statement: def termsOfLink Λ := {γ | S.termDisc γ ≠ 0 ∧ link γ = Λ}

splitGrammulVec.name: splitGram_mulVec
splitGrammulVec.statement:
lemma splitGram_mulVec v : T.splitGram *ᵥ v =
  (v <| eStar ·) ⊕ᵥ (T *ᵥ (v <| inr <| inl ·) ⊕ᵥ (v <| inl ·))

linkMatrixmulVec.name: linkMatrix_mulVec
linkMatrixmulVec.statement:
@[simp ↓] lemma linkMatrix_mulVec t : linkMatrix γ *ᵥ t = (t <| inr <| inl ·) ⊕ᵥ
    (γ⁻¹.1.1 *ᵥ t <| inr <| inl ·)

isotropicFramePairmulVeceqzeroiff.name: isotropicFramePair_mulVec_eq_zero_iff
isotropicFramePairmulVeceqzeroiff.statement:
@[simp ↓] lemma isotropicFramePair_mulVec_eq_zero_iff {t} :
  t ∈ ((isotropicFramePair γ)ᴴ * T.splitGram).mulVecLin.ker ↔ (∀ a, t (eStar a) = 0) ∧
  ∀ a, (γ⁻¹.1.1 *ᵥ t) (eStar a) = 0

memlink.name: mem_link
memlink.statement: lemma mem_link {p} : p ∈ link γ ↔ ∃ a, (γ.1.1 *ᵥ (a ⊕ᵥ (p ∘ inr ⊕ᵥ 0))) ∘ inr = p ∘ inl ⊕ᵥ 0

invb.name: IsNormalForm.inv

existsframeImageeqofisNormalForm.name: Filling.exists_frameImage_eq_of_isNormalForm
existsframeImageeqofisNormalForm.statement:

isStablehasLevel.statement: lemma Filling.isStable_hasLevel j : S.IsStable {γ | S.HasLevel j γ}
